```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Load "Read Excel Files" package
library(readxl)

### Load Package "Network Meta-Analysis using Frequentist Methods"
library(netmeta)

### Load "Meta-Analysis Package for R"
library(metafor)

### Load "General Package for Meta-Analysis"
library(meta)

### Upload data from Excel file
outcomedata <- read_excel("S3-Appendix.xlsx")
```

# Network Geometry
## Overall Network Connectedness
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
network <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "full_network" & time == "none")
nc1 <- netconnection(treat1, treat2, studlab, data=network)
nc1
```

## Category Geometry
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
networkCATEGORY <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "category" & time == "none")
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, tol.multiarm = 1, data=networkCATEGORY)
netgraph(nma, points = TRUE, cex.points=3, thickness = "number.of.studies")
```

## Pharmacological Geometry
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
networkPHARM <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "pharmacological" & time == "none")
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, tol.multiarm = 1, data=networkPHARM)
netgraph(nma, points = TRUE, cex.points=3, thickness = "number.of.studies")
```

## Psychological Geometry
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
networkPSYCH <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "psychological" & time == "none")
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=networkPSYCH)
netgraph(nma, points = TRUE, cex.points=3, thickness = "number.of.studies")
```
\newpage

# Pharmacological Interventions (Post-Intervention)
## Remission from depression (post-intervention)
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
pharmRFDpost <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "remission_depression" & time == "pharm_post" & ref == "yes")
```

### Network connectedness
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nc1 <- netconnection(treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost)
nc1
```

### Network geometry
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost, sm="OR")
netgraph(nma, points = TRUE, cex.points=3, thickness = "number.of.studies")
```

### Network measures
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netmeasures(nma, random=TRUE)
```

### Distance matrix
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netdistance(nma)
```

### Design-based decomposition of Cochran’s Q
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
decomp.design(nma)
```

### Net heat plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netheat(nma, random=TRUE)
```

### Split direct and indirect evidence
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ns <- netsplit(nma)
print(ns, comb.fixed=FALSE)
```

### Effect estimates - all treatment comparisons
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost, comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR")
nma
```

### Effect estimates - versus placebo
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost, reference.group = "Pharmacological Placebos", comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR")
nma
```

### Forest plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
forest(nma, sortvar=-Pscore, drop.reference.group = TRUE)
```

### League table
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netleague(nma, nma, comb.fixed=FALSE)
```

### Treatment ranking
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netrank(nma)
```
\newpage

## Health-related Quality of Life (post-intervention)
### SSRIs vs NMDA Antagonists
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
SSRIsvNMDA <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "QoL" & time == "pharm_post" & ref == "yes" & studlab == "Muhonen 2008")
pharmQoL_SSRIsvNMDA <- rma(yi=TE, sei=seTE, knha=TRUE, measure="SMD", data=SSRIsvNMDA)
pharmQoL_SSRIsvNMDA
forest(pharmQoL_SSRIsvNMDA, showweights=TRUE, refline=0, xlab = "SMD", mlab = "Summary Estimate", alim = c(2,2), xlim = c(-5,5))
```
\newpage

# Pharmacological Interventions (Follow-up)
## Remission from alcohol (long-term follow-up)
### SSRIs vs Placebo
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
SSRIsvPlacebo <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "remission_alcohol" & time == "pharm_long" & ref == "yes")
pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo <- rma(yi=TE, sei=seTE, knha=TRUE, measure="OR", data=SSRIsvPlacebo)
pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo
predict(pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo, transf=exp)
forest(pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo, showweights=TRUE, refline=1, xlab = "Odds Ratio", mlab = "Summary Estimate", transf = exp, alim = c(0,2), xlim = c(-5,5))
```
\newpage

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nc1 <- netconnection(treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost)
nc1
```

#### Network geometry
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost, sm="OR", tol.multiarm = 1)
netgraph(nma, points = TRUE, cex.points=3, thickness = "number.of.studies")
```

#### Network measures
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netmeasures(nma, random=TRUE)
```

#### Distance matrix
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netdistance(nma)
```

#### Design-based decomposition of Cochran’s Q
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
decomp.design(nma)
```

#### Net heat plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netheat(nma, random=TRUE)
```

#### Split direct and indirect evidence
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ns <- netsplit(nma)
print(ns, comb.fixed=FALSE)
```

#### Effect estimates - all treatment comparisons
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost, comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR", tol.multiarm = 1)
```

#### Effect estimates - versus placebo
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost, reference.group = "No additional treatment", comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR", tol.multiarm = 1)
nma
```

#### Forest plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
forest(nma, sortvar=-Pscore, drop.reference.group = TRUE)
```

#### League table
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netleague(nma, nma, comb.fixed=FALSE)
```

#### Treatment ranking


# Sensitivity - Decision Space
## Remission from depression (post-intervention)

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nc1 <- netconnection(treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost)
nc1
```

### Network geometry
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost, sm="OR")
netgraph(nma, points = TRUE, cex.points=3, thickness = "number.of.studies")
```

### Network measures
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netmeasures(nma, random=TRUE)
```

### Distance matrix
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netdistance(nma)
```

### Design-based decomposition of Cochran’s Q
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
decomp.design(nma)
```

### Net heat plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netheat(nma, random=TRUE)
```

### Split direct and indirect evidence
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ns <- netsplit(nma)
print(ns, comb.fixed=FALSE)
```

### Effect estimates - all treatment comparisons
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost, comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR")
nma
```

### Effect estimates - versus placebo
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=pharmRFDpost, reference.group = "Pharmacological Placebos", comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR")
nma
```

### Forest plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
forest(nma, sortvar=-Pscore, drop.reference.group = TRUE)
```

### League table

### Treatment ranking

# Sensitivity - Pharmacological Interventions (Follow-up)
## Remission from alcohol (long-term follow-up)
### SSRIs vs Placebo
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
SSRIsvPlacebo <- subset(outcomedata, domain == "remission_alcohol" & time == "pharm_long" & sensitivity_1 == "yes")
pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo <- rma(yi=TE, sei=seTE, knha=TRUE, measure="OR", data=SSRIsvPlacebo)
pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo
predict(pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo, transf=exp)
forest(pharmRFAlong_SSRIsvPlacebo, showweights=TRUE, refline=1, xlab = "Odds Ratio", mlab = "Summary Estimate", transf = exp, alim = c(0,2), xlim = c(-5,5))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

```

#### Network connectedness
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nc1 <- netconnection(treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost)
nc1
```

#### Network geometry
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost, sm="OR", tol.multiarm = 1)
netgraph(nma, points = TRUE, cex.points=3, thickness = "number.of.studies")
```

#### Network measures
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netmeasures(nma, random=TRUE)
```

#### Distance matrix
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netdistance(nma)
```

#### Design-based decomposition of Cochran’s Q
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
decomp.design(nma)
```

#### Net heat plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netheat(nma, random=TRUE)
```

#### Split direct and indirect evidence
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ns <- netsplit(nma)
print(ns, comb.fixed=FALSE)
```

#### Effect estimates - all treatment comparisons
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost, comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR", tol.multiarm = 1)
nma
```

#### Effect estimates - versus placebo
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
nma <- netmeta(TE, seTE, treat1, treat2, studlab, data=psycRFApost, reference.group = "No additional treatment", comb.fixed=FALSE, sm="OR", tol.multiarm = 1)
nma
```

#### Forest plot
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
forest(nma, sortvar=-Pscore, drop.reference.group = TRUE)
```

#### League table
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netleague(nma, nma, comb.fixed=FALSE)
```

#### Treatment ranking
```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
netrank(nma)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
psycWCshort_SMSvPlacebo <- rma(yi=TE, sei=seTE, knha=TRUE, measure="SMD", data=SMSvPlacebo)
psycWCshort_SMSvPlacebo
forest(psycWCshort_SMSvPlacebo, showweights=TRUE, refline=0, xlab = "SMD", mlab = "Summary Estimate", alim = c(2,2), xlim = c(-5,5))
```
